396:t_000:7.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You seem distracted. ...Are you worried about what happened this afternoon?」

396:t_000:8.en:
$$レド$$
「...Everyone scolded me afterward. They said that was a creature called an octopus, not a $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$.」

396:t_000:9.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You startled me a little when you suddenly drew your gun.」

396:t_000:11.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Hey... Anyway, our dancing... Did you watch it properly?」

396:t_003:0.en:
$$レド$$
「$$ヒディアーズ#robot$$! I won't let you near $$ガルガンティア$$... or $$エイミー$$!」

396:t_004:0.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I confirm that the target has been annihilated.」

396:t_004:1.en:
$$レド$$
「Collect a tissue sample. Amplify and analyze its genes.」

396:t_004:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand. However, a result differing from the unique signature analysis is unlikely.」

396:t_004:3.en:
$$レド$$
「I know. I want to find out whether Earth's $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ have any unique characteristics.」

396:t_004:5.en:
$$レド$$
(The $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ invasion has reached this Earth... Could they... have transferred here with me...?)

396:t_004:6.en:
$$レド$$
(But... If that was one of those creatures called $$クジライカ$$ that Captain $$ジェフリー$$ warned us about, they existed here before my transfer...)

396:t_004:7.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$. Biological analysis is possible, but I cannot obtain information on the target's invasion strategy.」

396:t_004:8.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll gather information from the fleet. I need to know their total numbers and range of activity.」

396:t_004:9.en:
$$レド$$
「As soon as that's done, I'll annihilate them.」

396:t_100:0.en:
$$レド$$
「It seems they've evolved to adapt to life underwater...!」

396:t_100:1.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I advise you that my operations underwater are limited.」

396:t_100:2.en:
$$レド$$
「We'll do it anyway! We can't leave the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ alive!」

401:t_1:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...I confirm that the final target has been destroyed.」

401:t_1:5.en:
$$レド$$
「We've cleared out most of them, then. They were more fragile than I expected.」

401:t_1:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I infer that they adapted through degeneration due to an absence of natural predators.」

401:t_1:7.en:
$$レド$$
「Once we've secured the area, I'll contact $$ピニオン$$ on the surface.」

401:t_1:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The remaining Earth-type $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ appear to have fled.」

401:t_1:9.en:
$$レド$$
「We'll annihilate them later. First, we'll investigate the nest.」

401:t_1:11.en:
$$レド$$
「...Those small humanoid creatures we saw on the way... What were they?」

401:t_1:12.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I infer that they were immature $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$.」

401:t_1:13.en:
$$レド$$
「Those were young $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$...?」

401:t_1:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Much of the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ life cycle is unknown. This is valuable information.」

401:t_1:15.en:
$$レド$$
「But what is this place...? It looks like some kind of facility...」

401:t_1:16.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Based on $$ピニオン$$'s information, I conclude that this facility belonged to a lost civilization in the world of the $$残されの海$$.」

401:t_1:17.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Further, I infer that this is the facility's administrative block.」

401:t_1:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have recovered what appears to be a recording medium designed for extreme environments.」

401:t_1:21.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have successfully accessed the medium. I am searching for the relevant data standard.」

401:t_1:22.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have found a similar standard and activated the inference engine. I will attempt restoration and translation.」

401:t_1:23.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have completed the restoration.」

401:t_1:25.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I cannot disclose the data.」

401:t_1:27.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have determined that this is a research facility of the old-world civilization.」

401:t_1:28.en:
$$レド$$
「Then... The $$残されの海$$ existed in the same world as the $$人類銀河同盟$$, and this truly was the birthplace of the Alliance's people...」

401:t_1:29.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The details of this data fall under $$人類銀河同盟$$ classified information.」

401:t_1:30.en:
$$レド$$
「Classified...!? What good is that at a time like this!?」

401:t_1:31.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「It is a military regulation.」

401:t_1:32.en:
$$レド$$
「Consider our situation! When contact with the main force is lost, the highest-ranking person on site has command! Correct!?」

401:t_1:34.en:
$$レド$$
「Who is the highest-ranking person here!?」

401:t_1:35.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Ensign $$レド$$ is the highest-ranking person.」

401:t_1:36.en:
$$レド$$
「Ensign $$レド$$ requests that $$パイロット支援啓発インターフェイス$$ System $$チェインバー#pilot$$ disclose the classified information.」

401:t_1:37.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand. I will execute the order.」

401:t_1:42.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「...Now is the time for humanity to move beyond this tragic conflict and walk forward on its own two feet.」

401:t_1:43.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「To discuss one such effort, we have invited Mr. $$ライアン・マツモト$$, a member of the actively campaigning $$イボルバー$$.」

401:t_1:44.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Thank you for having me.」

401:t_1:45.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「Today's special news program is being broadcast live.」

401:t_1:46.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「Mr. $$マツモト$$. I hear you have something important to tell us today...」

401:t_1:47.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Yes... I hope to give you some insight into our activities.」

401:t_1:48.en:
$$マツモト$$
「As residents of an Earth facing irreversible catastrophe, I hope all of you watching this program will think about our future with me.」

401:t_1:49.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「I hear the $$地球連邦$$ Assembly is leaning toward promoting lunar emigration while waiting for the environment to recover on its own.」

401:t_1:50.en:
$$マツモト$$
「I do not wish to deny that approach. We simply chose to forge our future ourselves, rather than wait for things to improve.」

401:t_1:51.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「But your group, the $$自発進化推進派$$... commonly called the $$イボルバー$$, has provoked various forms of opposition worldwide.」

401:t_1:52.en:
$$マツモト$$
「...This is speculation, but we believe someone is inciting that opposition.」

401:t_1:53.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「Who is this someone?」

401:t_1:54.en:
$$マツモト$$
「We are investigating the details, but they lurk in the shadows of history, seeking to control humanity's evolution like gods.」

401:t_1:55.en:
$$ニュースキャスター$$
「That is... a shocking statement...」

401:t_1:56.en:
$$マツモト$$
「Since that giant meteor fell, Earth has been subjected to the ordeal known as nuclear winter.」

401:t_1:57.en:
$$マツモト$$
「I admit that little has been said about the $$イボルバー$$' activities until now, and that has led to misunderstandings.」

401:t_1:58.en:
$$マツモト$$
「It is also true that many fear rapid scientific development will destroy long-held traditions and undermine human happiness.」

401:t_1:59.en:
$$マツモト$$
「But religion, tradition, and the way we live have changed along with scientific progress.」
